stem.en: Which statement about Mehrgarh agrees with the book?

text.en: Its people built sun-dried brick houses, grew wheat and barley, and raised sheep, goats and Indian cattle.
Its people lived only by hunting until a city was built there in 2500 BCE.

feedback.en: Mehrgarh was a farming village from about 7000 BCE, and it did not become a city.

text.en: It lies on the Ganga, and its people grew rice from about 7000 BCE.

feedback.en: Mehrgarh lies on the Bolan river, and its crops were wheat and barley.

text.en: Its people first made bronze tools around 7000 BCE.

feedback.en: About 7000 BCE is the date of the village. Copper came by about 4000 BCE, and the Bronze Age came later.

explanation.en: The book says that the people of Mehrgarh built handmade sun-dried brick houses and granaries, cultivated wheat and barley, and raised sheep, goats and Indian cattle, especially the zebu.

hints.en: Recall the river, the crops and the date of the village.
